name: Archaeologist Hollee
summary: In Auberdine, Archaeologist Hollee tracks dwarven research across Darkshore. The ancient ruins draw Ironforge scholars to the coast, where she keeps in touch with prospectors searching for relics and unusual geological formations.

sections.title: A Dwarven Scholar in Kaldorei Lands
sections.body: Archaeologist Hollee works from Auberdine, among the night elves who guard and settle Darkshore. The dwarven scholar is a regional contact for surveyors and expedition teams crossing the wilderness. The Explorers' League sends its people across the sea to uncover traces of ancient history, and Darkshore's ruins give them ground to study.

sections.title: Keeping Tabs on Remtravel
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel is one of the field researchers Hollee keeps track of. Given important surveys along the wild coast, he often wanders far from his work and misses his reporting schedule. Hollee asks travelers passing through Auberdine to find him, recover missing survey data, and keep the research safe from local wildlife and other threats.

faq.answer: Archaeologist Hollee is a dwarf in Auberdine who conducts and oversees field research for dwarven archaeological efforts on Kalimdor's western coast.
Hollee can be found in Auberdine, the coastal port town on Darkshore's western shore.

faq.q: Why are dwarves conducting research in Darkshore?
faq.answer: After the Third War, closer ties between Ironforge and the night elves brought dwarven researchers to Kalimdor. They study ancient relics, geological formations, and buried history that may shed light on dwarven ancestry.

faq.q: What trouble does she need help with?
faq.answer: Hollee is concerned about Prospector Remtravel, an absent-minded surveyor who wandered into southern Darkshore and failed to report his findings.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Hollee and Prospector Remtravel?
faq.answer: Hollee and Prospector Remtravel are colleagues in Darkshore's excavation and survey work. Remtravel studies ruins in the field, while Hollee coordinates reports and speaks with travelers in Auberdine.

faq.q: Does Hollee belong to the Explorers' League?
faq.answer: Hollee represents dwarven archaeological and prospecting expeditions allied with Ironforge. Such expeditions are typically organized under the Explorers' League, which operates from the Eastern Kingdoms.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a compatriot across the sea in Darkshore's misty woods recalls Ironforge's drive to uncover ancient history.
As an Alliance member, you can see Hollee's work as cooperation between the Eastern Kingdoms and the night elves, with Auberdine as a base for studying Kalimdor's past.
